Ananya Bansal
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Pune, Maharashtra
ananya.bansal557@example.com | +91 9429392717

Experienced Talent Acquisition professional with a strong blend of recruitment operations and payroll exposure across technology and consulting environments. Effective at sourcing and closing mid-to-senior level roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, managing onboarding and payroll coordination, and partnering with hiring managers to improve time-to-hire. Notice period: 30 days.

Orbit Health, Mar 2024 - Present
Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote)

- Managed end-to-end onboarding and coordinated payroll inputs for 40+ new hires, ensuring accurate new-joiner data and resolving payroll discrepancies within 5 business days.
- Partnered with hiring managers to define role profiles and implemented a standardized interview scorecard, improving hiring manager satisfaction by measured feedback.

Trellis Systems, Jan 2022 - Feb 2024
Recruiter (Hybrid)
- Sourced and screened candidates for engineering and customer success roles using LinkedIn Recruiter, delivering a 25% increase in pipeline quality measured by interview-to-offer conversion.
- Managed recruitment workflow in Confluence and Git-tracked candidate tracker artifacts to maintain versioned hiring documentation and ensure auditability.
- Coordinated offer process and closure logistics, achieving an offer acceptance rate of 82% for prioritized roles.

Vertex Analytics, Jun 2021 - Dec 2021
Talent Acquisition Specialist (On-site)
- Executed recruitment campaigns for analytics and data engineering roles, leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter to build a shortlist of 60 qualified candidates resulting in 12 hires in one quarter.
- Processed and validated payroll inputs for contractors and new employees, liaising with finance to resolve payment issues within standard payroll cycles.
- Implemented talent acquisition tracking in Confluence and refined candidate evaluation rubrics, reducing duplicate sourcing efforts by 30%.

Accenture, Nov 2018 - May 2021
Finance Executive (On-site)
- Managed month-end accounting tasks using Tally, ensuring GST-compliant invoicing and reconciliations for multiple client projects with zero audit findings.
- Prepared GST filings and supported internal audits, reducing filing discrepancies by implementing a checklist-driven process.
- Collaborated with project managers to track billing milestones and improve collection cycles by 15% through timely invoicing and follow-up.

Projects

- Payroll Reconciliation Template: Built a standardized payroll reconciliation template used across hires at Orbit Health and Vertex Analytics, reducing data errors during payroll runs.
